collection.description: A man discovers an unexpected pregnancy.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1) discovers an unexpected pregnancy. He feels no immediate certainty about whether he wants to continue it, and he resents villagers who assume they know his answer.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: He learns what options and support are available to him.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The healer cannot answer everything and helps him find more guidance.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They listen and leave the decision to him.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Their initial reaction is unhelpful, and he asks for space.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: He identifies what he wants and what he fears.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: He remains uncertain and gives himself more time where possible.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: He learns what each path would involve for his health and daily life.

text_only.reason: health or an injury talked about in the story; nobody's health changes -- story only: the file marks no effect (no new mechanics)

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Some answers are difficult, but the information helps him decide.
